verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at https://portkey.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a Portkey product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it. Beyond that, the agent-oriented surface is thin: the docs.md and OpenAPI probes both returned 404, and nothing shows how complete the llms.txt is. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth and coverage (e.g. links to the full docs or an llms-full.txt), markdown versions of the docs pages, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and first-party documentation describing agent-oriented docs.
